entries.why: the /2 index (an older rootmark's) answers search 503 migration_required, not index_stale (K-P2A.2); the other 7 cases unchanged

paths.prefix: migration_required: index format "mdkernel-index/2" (an older rootmark's) needs migration to "mdkernel-index/3"

paths.expect: index stale: format mdkernel-index/2, this rootmark expects mdkernel-index/3; search is unavailable (migration_required or index_stale) until then; blame, history, checkpoints and traces work; migrate: run `rootmark migrate <vault>` (see `--dry-run`), or rebuild: run `rootmark index build <vault>`, or set [index] auto_rebuild = true in .rootmark/policy.toml and restart `rootmark serve`
